description: This file contains implementation of provider runtime plugin management, including functions for resolving, caching, and applying provider plugins and their hooks within a larger system. It manages plugin resolution, cache invalidation, and plugin-based extensions for provider models and configurations.

methods.name: matchesProviderId
methods.description: Checks if a given provider plugin matches a provider ID after normalization.

methods.name: resolveHookProviderCacheBucket
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache bucket for provider hooks based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: buildHookProviderCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string for provider hook resolution based on configuration, workspace, plugin IDs, and environment.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginsForHooks
methods.description: Resolves provider plugins for hooks, utilizing caching based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveProviderPluginsForCatalogHooks
methods.description: Resolves provider plugins specifically for catalog-related hooks, filtering by plugin IDs.

methods.name: resolveProviderRuntimePlugin
methods.description: Finds the provider plugin for a specific provider string, considering ownership and matching.

methods.name: runProviderDynamicModel
methods.description: Executes the resolveDynamicModel hook of a provider plugin to get a dynamic model.

methods.name: prepareProviderDynamicModel
methods.description: Calls the prepareDynamicModel hook asynchronously for a provider plugin.

methods.name: normalizeProviderResolvedModelWithPlugin
methods.description: Normalizes a provider's resolved model using the plugin's normalization hook.

methods.name: applyProviderResolvedModelCompatWithPlugins
methods.description: Applies compatibility patches to a provider's resolved model via plugin contributions.

methods.name: applyProviderResolvedTransportWithPlugin
methods.description: Normalizes transport settings of a provider's model via plugin hooks.

methods.name: normalizeProviderModelIdWithPlugin

methods.name: normalizeProviderTransportWithPlugin
